newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama prison riot leaves one dead, five injured.
newsitem.headline: Panama prison riot leaves one dead, five injured.

text.p: One inmate was killed and five others injured in a fight between rival gangs in a Panama City prison on Tuesday, police said.

"The riot started this morning. I understand there is one dead and five injured," a police spokeswoman said. The number of inmates involved and other details about the incident at La Joya jail were not immediately available.

Local RPC television said rivalries inside the jail stemmed from a group of inmates who were transferred there from the notoriously violent and overcrowded Modelo prison, which was destroyed by the authorities earlier this month.
